note: کیس‌هایِ B3: هشت مسیرِ پورت‌شده رویِ نمادهایِ برگرفته از همان کپیِ یخ‌زده. «{role}» درِ gate_b3.py با نخستین نمادِ آن پرس‌وجو جایگزین می‌شود؛ نقشی که داده نداشته باشد کیسش حذف و در شاهد ثبت می‌شود (نه اینکه کیسِ بی‌محتوا سبز بماند). GET /api/chart/{symbol} درِ این فهرست نیست: پایتون ۲۰۰ و Go ۵۰۱ می‌دهد و گیت آن را جدا اندازه می‌گیرد.

roles.deep: SELECT symbol, COUNT(*) c FROM price_history GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY c DESC, symbol LIMIT 1
roles.adjust: SELECT ph.symbol, COUNT(*) c FROM price_history ph JOIN instruments i ON i.l_val18 = ph.symbol JOIN price_adjust_events p ON p.ins_code = i.ins_code WHERE i.l_val18 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ph.symbol ORDER BY c DESC, ph.symbol LIMIT 1
roles.events: SELECT a.symbol, COUNT(*) c FROM adjust_events a JOIN price_history ph ON ph.symbol = a.symbol GROUP BY a.symbol HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY c DESC, a.symbol LIMIT 1
roles.verdict: SELECT v.symbol, COUNT(*) c FROM adjust_verdict v JOIN price_history ph ON ph.symbol = v.symbol WHERE v.source <> '' GROUP BY v.symbol ORDER BY c DESC, v.symbol LIMIT 1
roles.book: SELECT i.l_val18, COUNT(*) c FROM order_book ob JOIN instruments i ON i.ins_code = ob.ins_code WHERE ob.book_txt IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ob.book_txt) > 20 GROUP BY i.l_val18 ORDER BY MAX(ob.d_even) DESC, i.l_val18 LIMIT 1
roles.watch: SELECT i.l_val18, COUNT(*) c FROM instruments i JOIN market_watch m ON m.ins_code = i.ins_code JOIN price_history ph ON ph.symbol = i.l_val18 WHERE m.p_closing > 0 AND m.q_tot_tran > 0 GROUP BY i.l_val18 ORDER BY MAX(m.d_even) DESC, i.l_val18 LIMIT 1
roles.short: SELECT symbol, COUNT(*) c FROM price_history GROUP BY symbol HAVING c BETWEEN 12 AND 60 ORDER BY c ASC, symbol LIMIT 1
roles.thin: SELECT symbol, COUNT(*) c FROM price_history GROUP BY symbol HAVING c BETWEEN 2 AND 11 ORDER BY c ASC, symbol LIMIT 1
roles.absent: SELECT i.l_val18, 0 FROM instruments i LEFT JOIN price_history ph ON ph.symbol = i.l_val18 WHERE ph.symbol IS NULL AND i.l_val18 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.l_val18 ORDER BY i.l_val18 LIMIT 1
roles.corporate: SELECT i.l_val18, COUNT(*) c FROM instruments i JOIN share_change_events s ON s.ins_code = i.ins_code JOIN price_history ph ON ph.symbol = i.l_val18 GROUP BY i.l_val18 ORDER BY c DESC, i.l_val18 LIMIT 1
